item.title: Lawyers for ex-Hudson's Bay employees ask court to approve hardship fund
item.description: TORONTO — Lawyers representing former Hudson's Bay employees are asking a court to approve two new mechanisms meant to help staff cope with the fall of the department store.

item.title: 2026 NHL draft prospect Gavin McKenna facing assault charges
item.description: STATE COLLEGE — Gavin McKenna, a top prospect for the 2026 NHL draft, is facing assault charges. McKenna, a freshman at Penn State, has been charged with aggravated assault by police in State College, Pa.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie posts message to her mother's kidnapper asking to provide proof she is alive
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. (AP) — NBC “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie sent a public message to her 84-year-old mother’s kidnapper on Wednesday saying that her family is ready to talk but wants proof that she is alive.

item.title: Vancouver FC falls 3-0 in first leg vs. Cruz Azul in CONCACAF Champions Cup
item.description: LANGLEY — Vancouver FC is off to a rough start in the CONCACAF Champions Cup. The Canadian Premier League side lost 3-0 to Cruz Azul in the first leg of round one play on Wednesday at Willoughby Community Park.

item.title: Kindergarten readiness varies widely by income, new data shows. Cities are stepping in to help
item.description: SAN ANTONIO (AP) — Sandra Mosqueda watched with an amused smile as her 2-year-old son, Atreus, began sweeping the floor with a miniature mop.

item.title: Is your child ready to register for kindergarten? Here's what experts look for
item.description: New federal data shows about two-thirds of the nation’s 3- to 5-year-olds are on track to enter kindergarten. But being ready for school involves a lot more than a child’s ability to count or recite their ABCs.

item.title: Flames take season series, hand Oilers third consecutive loss
item.description: CALGARY — Rookie Matvei Gridin had a goal and an assist for his first multi-point NHL game to lead the Calgary Flames to a 4-3 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday.

item.title: Golden Knights end 5-game skid with 5-2 victory over Canucks
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — Jack Eichel had a goal and an assist and the Vegas Golden Knights snapped a five-game losing streak with a 5-2 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Wednesday night.

item.title: Marchand's shootout goal gives Panthers 5-4 win over Bruins
item.description: SUNRISE, Fla. (AP) — Brad Marchand scored in the fourth round of the shootout in his return to Florida’s lineup after missing two games to give the Panthers a 5-4 win over the Boston Bruins, his former team, on Wednesday night.
